question: How did Gideon calm the anger of the Ephraimites?
options: He gave them gold from the plunder
He said their gleanings were better than Abiezer's full harvest, since God gave them Oreb and Zeeb
He made their leader a judge
explanation: Gideon humbly said Ephraim had done more than he had, because God gave the Midianite leaders Oreb and Zeeb into their hands. Then their anger calmed down.
